ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, fair value (gains) losses on equity and limited partnership investments, impairments and other charges, pension settlement losses, acquisition-related items, product-line disposition gains and contract settlement expense, then deducts the aggregate tax effect and removes discrete tax items. MCPS: per-share adjustments assume all MCPS converted ('if-converted' regardless of dilution); adjusted diluted shares = GAAP diluted shares + converted shares of anti-dilutive MCPS, and the related MCPS dividends are added back. Adjusted diluted shares 744.6m (736.0m + 8.6m MCPS B converted shares); MCPS A converted 15-Apr-2022 (1.1m weighted shares in GAAP diluted). Release EPS headings now 'from continuing operations'. Item amounts from release footnotes.
